comment: Read from src/TwinPeaks.cpp and src/filter/ripples.hpp at commit fb01326, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.11.1. The manual describes FM A and FM B as controlling the total amount of modulation, which is right: ripples.hpp:154 multiplies the whole sum of FM jack, TRACK and XFM-B by that knob before it reaches the cutoff. ripples.hpp:156 then takes the minimum of that sum and zero, so upward modulation past the knob's own 20kHz maximum does nothing; the manual does not mention the cap. The LP-TWP jack is the one input on the module that is read outside the polyphony loop (TwinPeaks.cpp:130), so it is monophonic while everything else follows the audio input's channel count. ripples.hpp:163 adds a microvolt of noise to the input, which is what starts self-oscillation.
